title: Shangela starts the lipstick message
summary: After becoming Season 2's first eliminated queen (US-S02-E01), Shangela wrote a farewell message in lipstick on her workstation mirror — starting a Drag Race tradition continued by later porkchop queens.

title: The first Snatch Game
summary: Season 2 introduced Snatch Game (US-S02-E04). Tatianna won as Britney Spears; Sonique was eliminated after lip-syncing to "Two of Hearts."

title: Tyra Sanchez wins Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S02-E11), Tyra Sanchez and Raven lip-synced to "Jealous of My Boogie (Gomi and RasJek Edit)." Tyra was crowned; Raven was runner-up. The Season 2 cash prize was $25,000.

title: Untucked debuts with Season 2
summary: Season 2 was the first to air RuPaul's Drag Race Untucked as a companion behind-the-scenes show after each week's episode.

title: Pandora Boxx Miss Congeniality
summary: Pandora Boxx was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers, announced at the Season 2 reunion (US-S02-E12).
